Title: Getting Started
Link: https://docs.solidatus.com/solidatus-6.5/connectors/connector-specific-documentation/java-connector-sdk/getting-started
Content: The simplest way to get started is to use the Spring Initializr at https://start.spring.io to generate a downloadable Maven project for you!

Select your preferred build tool Maven or Gradle, Spring Boot version and your Java version.

You can even enter the GAV metadata details for your project.

Then simply click the Generate button to download a zip file of your project setup, unzip and open in your preferred Java IDE.

For an example Solidatus Java Connector, please see our provided example project. If you do not have access to this project please ask your Solidatus contact for next steps.
Title: Getting Started
Link: https://docs.solidatus.com/solidatus-2026.1/connectors/connector-specific-documentation/java-connector-sdk/getting-started
Content: Add the Solidatus Java Connector SDK dependency to your Gradle project's build.gradle

dependencies {
	implementation 'com.solidatus.spring:solidatus-spring-boot-starter:0.1.30'
}

The Solidatus Spring Boot Starter includes a dependency for the Solidatus Java Client, this is the client generated from Solidatus Open API specification. The SDK uses the Java client to make API calls to the Solidatus server.

Title: Create and analyse charts
Link: https://docs.solidatus.com/solidatus-2026.1/data-domains/analytics-reports/create-and-analyse-charts
Content: To start using Tiles, you first have to create metrics so you have values to populate charts and infographics with.

Once you’ve created some metrics, go to the Tiles tab of your Analytics Report to create your first Tile.

Click + TILE, which appears on an empty Tiles page and at the top-right of an Analytics Report.

The dialog for creating a tile guides you through the four simple steps.

Step 1: Name and describe the chart
Step 2: Select metrics to display
Step 3: Select a type of chart
Step 4: Preview your tile
